description: This source file is a Spring configuration class that sets up a batch job for applying annual fees to savings accounts in the Fineract platform. It defines beans for the job, a step, and a tasklet, and wires in the necessary services and repositories.

classes.name: ApplyAnnualFeeForSavingsConfig
classes.description: Spring configuration class that defines beans for job setup to apply annual savings fees.

methods.name: applyAnnualFeeForSavingsStep
methods.description: Creates and returns a batch Step that executes the tasklet for applying annual fees.

methods.name: applyAnnualFeeForSavingsJob
methods.description: Creates and returns a batch Job that runs the apply annual fee step.

methods.name: applyAnnualFeeForSavingsTasklet
methods.description: Creates and returns the tasklet responsible for applying annual fees to savings accounts.
